papers.title: The Many Senses of Visual Similarity: A Text-Prompted Image Perceptual Metric
papers.summary: Human visual similarity judgments are context-dependent. For example, two images may be similar in shape but distinct in color. Existing perceptual similarity metrics, however, collapse these nuances into a single scalar value, offering no mechanism to condition on specific aspects. To bridge this g
papers.titleZh: 视觉相似性的多重含义：一种由文本提示驱动的图像感知度量
papers.summaryZh: 人类的视觉相似判断依赖具体情境（例如两图形状相似但颜色不同）。现有感知相似度量将这种差异压缩成单一标量，无法按特定维度进行条件化。本文提出一种由文本提示驱动的图像感知相似度量，可对相似性的不同面向进行条件控制。

papers.title: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
papers.summary: Pretrained dense visual features from Vision Transformers (ViTs) are powerful yet have been underutilized in robot learning. Modern robot policies either compress each observation into a single global token, or rely on visual backbones trained from scratch, sacrificing both fine-grained spatial deta
papers.titleZh: Patch Policy：通过稠密视觉表征实现高效具身控制
papers.summaryZh: 来自 Vision Transformer（ViT）的预训练稠密视觉特征强大却鲜少用于机器人学习。本文提出 Patch Policy，利用稠密视觉表征保留细粒度空间细节，实现高效的具身（机器人）控制。

papers.title: Automated Discovery Has No Universally Superior Harness
papers.summary: Autonomous discovery systems such as OpenEvolve and TTT-Discover are often used as general-purpose harnesses. However, in practice these are composite systems combining several design choices about archives, parent selection, exploration, and budget allocation into a single recipe. Because discovery
papers.titleZh: 自动发现并不存在普遍更优的框架（harness）
papers.summaryZh: OpenEvolve、TTT-Discover 等自主发现系统常被当作通用框架使用，但实际上它们是档案、父代选择、探索与预算分配等多种设计选择的组合。本文表明不存在普遍更优的 harness，不同任务需不同配置。

papers.title: It's Not What You Say, It's How You Say It: Evaluating LLM Responses to Expressions of Belief
papers.summary: Users frequently express their beliefs to large language models (LLMs). In some situations, the LLM should accept these contextual beliefs as true. In others, they should stick to their prior knowledge. Notably, users' expressions of belief (EoBs) can take linguistically diverse forms - using presup
papers.titleZh: 重点不在你说什么，而在你怎么说：评估 LLM 对信念表达的回应
papers.summaryZh: 用户常以多样的语言形式向 LLM 表达自身信念。本文研究 LLM 应在何时接受这些信念为真、何时坚持自身先验知识，并构建了相应的评估基准。

papers.title: Simple Domain Generalization for Strong Pixel-Level Image Tampering Detection in Modern VLMs
papers.summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) have significantly improved image generation and editing capabilities, making pixel-level image tampering detection increasingly important yet challenging under cross-model and out-of-distribution shifts. papers.titleZh: 现代 VLM 中面向强像素级图像篡改检测的简易域泛化方法
papers.summaryZh: 随着现代视觉语言模型（VLM）的图像生成与编辑能力增强，跨模型、分布外场景下的像素级篡改检测愈发重要。本文研究了像素级图像篡改检测的域泛化（domain generalization）方法。

papers.title: Logical Judgments Under Pressure: Diagnosing Syllogistic Stability with Learned Soft Prefixes
papers.summary: To test how correct logical judgments respond to learned context, we prepend a soft prefix to an exactly labeled syllogistic reasoning benchmark while keeping the model fixed. papers.titleZh: 压力下的逻辑判断：用学习型软前缀诊断三段论稳定性
papers.summaryZh: 为检验正确逻辑判断如何受所学上下文影响，本文在精确标注的三段论推理基准前添加软前缀（soft prefix）并保持模型固定，通过受控变量刻画软前缀引发的行为变化。

papers.title: FlowMimic: Mask-free Visual Editing and Generation with Pixel-pair Warped Flow Field for Online Video Editing Data Generation and Modality Mimicry
papers.summary: In line with the prevailing direction of vision research, we explore the integration of both generation and editing capabilities for video and image modalities within a single model. Current approaches to collecting video editing data typically depend on labour-intensive, time-consuming curated proc
papers.titleZh: FlowMimic：基于像素对扭曲流场、面向在线视频编辑数据生成与模态模仿的无掩码视觉编辑与生成
papers.summaryZh: 本文探索在单一模型中同时集成视频与图像的生成与编辑能力，并提出 FlowMimic，利用像素对扭曲的流场（flow field）实现无掩码（mask-free）视觉编辑与生成，并用于自动生成在线视频编辑训练数据。

papers.title: Causal Discovery on Irregular Time Series
papers.summary: Causal discovery methods have shown strong performance in temporal systems, but they typically rely on regular and discrete lag structures, limiting their applicability to regularly sampled data. However, many real-world tasks require dealing with irregularly sampled streams of events, such as senso
papers.titleZh: 不规则时间序列上的因果发现
papers.summaryZh: 现有因果发现方法通常依赖规则、离散的滞后结构，难以处理不规则采样数据。本文提出适用于不规则时间序列（如传感器事件流）的因果发现方法。

papers.title: Vector Search As Nearest Neighbor Matching: RAG-based Policy Learning in Causal Inference
papers.summary: We propose one-step and two-step methods for policy learning with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We formulate RAG-based action selection under the potential outcome framework. In the two-step method, vector search retrieves action-specific neighboring evidence in an embedding space, the gener
papers.titleZh: 将向量检索视为最近邻匹配：因果推断中基于 RAG 的策略学习
papers.summaryZh: 本文在潜在结果（potential outcome）框架下提出一步与两步的检索增强生成（RAG）策略学习方法，其中向量检索在嵌入空间中召回与动作相关的邻近证据，用于因果推断中的策略学习。

papers.title: GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Efficient Pathology Foundation Models for Whole-Slide and Tumor Microenvironment Analysis
papers.summary: Foundation models have emerged as a driving force in computational pathology, with the potential to transform cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment selection by learning transferable representations from large-scale histopathology data. papers.titleZh: GigaPath-Flash 与 GigaTIME-Flash：面向全切片与肿瘤微环境分析的高效病理基础模型
papers.summaryZh: 基础模型正成为计算病理学的核心驱动力。本文提出 GigaPath-Flash 与 GigaTIME-Flash，高效的全切片（whole-slide）与肿瘤微环境分析病理基础模型，可助力癌症诊断、预后与治疗选择。

papers.title: HOMIE: Human-object Centric Video Personalization via Multimodal Intelligent Enchancement
papers.summary: Human-object centric video personalization (HOCVP) is a core task within subject-driven video generation. However, existing methods suffer from two key limitations. First, most approaches focusing on inter-subject personalization still struggle to strike a balance between high subject fidelity and a
papers.titleZh: HOMIE：通过多模态智能增强实现以人-物为中心的视频个性化
papers.summaryZh: 人以物为中心的视频个性化（HOCVP）是主体驱动视频生成的核心任务。本文提出 HOMIE，通过多模态智能增强（multimodal intelligent enhancement）在主体保真度与运动自然度之间取得更好平衡。

papers.title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
papers.summary: Pruning long context for coding agents has been a vital technology for efficient context management. While existing context pruning methods such as SWE-Pruner realize this by attaching a separate code classifier, we find the agent itself encodes internal representations indicating the relevance of c
papers.titleZh: SWE-Pruner Pro：编程 LLM 已知道该剪掉什么
papers.summaryZh: 为编码智能体裁剪长上下文是高效的上下文管理技术。现有方法（如 SWE-Pruner）依赖单独的分类器，而本文发现智能体自身已编码了代码相关性的内部表示，据此提出 SWE-Pruner Pro 直接利用模型内部信号剪枝。
